system_rank_inversions.explanation: Physics-IQ rewards clean empty backgrounds after a straight-line sprite shoots off-screen early, whereas foresight audit penalizes early border exits and mid-table pass-throughs.

Stopped-track endpoint error stops measuring whenever omni drops or blurs the object (8/15 vanished, 11/15 duplicated); counting vanished objects against fixed-horizon reality flips the error ordering.
